# dsh-clipbook · 小夹子
> **A clipbook for your DSH conversations.** One click on any assistant reply to keep it; a 🦊 button
in the session header opens your clips — browse, search, copy, delete, export.
DeepSeek Harness plugin · MIT · works on desktop **and** web
English | 简体中文
## What it does
- **🔖 夹一下 (Clip)** — every finalized assistant message gets a clip button. One click saves that repl

y (text + model + time + message id) into your clipbook.
- **🦊 小夹子 (N)** — a button in the session h
eader shows how many clips you have and opens a panel: browse, **search**, **copy**, **delete**, **e

xport to Markdown**.
- **Settings page** — the same shelf, another view.
- **One shelf, shared** — c
lips live in one file, so the web UI and the desktop app see the same collection.
## Why
DSH is all about long agent runs, and the good answers scroll away. 小夹子 is a place to keep the few l
ines worth keeping — a conclusion, a snippet, a phrasing — without copying them into another app.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH. Then, in any assistant message's action row you will see **🔖 夹一下**, and **🦊 小夹子** appea
rs in the session header.

| see your clips | clic

k **🦊 小夹子 (N)** in the session header |
| search | type in the box at the top of the panel |
| copy

one | **复制** |
| remove one | **拿掉** |
| export all | **导出** (opens the whole clipbook as Markdown)

ne | **复制** |

| export all | **导出** (opens the whole clipbook as Markdown) |
## Where data lives
`$DSH_HOME/clipbook/items.json` (`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`). Plain JSON — delete it to clear t
he shelf (it is recreated).
## Limits

- Clips the **text** of assistant replies (reasoning and tool output are not clipped).
- One shelf p
er `DSH_HOME` — that is a feature, not a clone-per-profile bug.

- **带走**: 「导出 Markdown」把

复**下方**点「🔖 夹一下」，那段话就进小夹子了。
